jobs.occupation: IT Specialist, AVEVA MES - Aarhus or Gdańsk
jobs.description:
Do you want to shape the production IT behind some of Europe’s largest dairies, and are you motivated by taking the AVEVA platform to the next level across more than 50 sites?

“To support our growth, we are looking for you to join Arla as an Aveva MES engineer to deliver great results within our MES environment. Together, we support Europe’s largest dairies, a wide range of products and the farmers who own Arla Foods through great IT solutions. By contributing to these solutions, you will make a real difference for the entire organization, and your colleagues near and far. Join us to help us create a dairy of the future,” says Arne Bo Jensen, Senior Manage, Head of IT Product.

How you will make an impact

The Arla AVEVA System Platform is installed in various versions on more than 50 dairy sites across Europe, where operational teams use it as their primary industrial software platform to monitor and optimise plant performance and execute global production targets. We are now upgrading the platform on all sites as an important step in Arla’s digitalisation strategy. You will join the AVEVA team within Digital Manufacturing in IT Solutions, working in a hybrid delivery model that combines Agile and traditional project methodologies. Working closely with your team, key business stakeholders and external consultants, you will be part of the ongoing development and rollout of the platform and help standardise solutions across all our dairies.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Migrating older platforms to the newest AVEVA System Platform.

• Developing and implementing new system functionality on AVEVA System Platform and InTouch.

• Performing performance testing in our Quality Test System.

• Deploying and rolling out application solutions to our sites, primarily through remote connections.

What will make you successful

You enjoy working close to production, where your solutions make a direct difference to how our dairies run. You are a valuable team member who thrives on close collaboration with colleagues, business stakeholders and external consultants across countries and cultures.

The ideal candidate brings:

• A degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar.

• 2+ years of experience with solutions such as AVEVA System Platform, AVEVA InTouch, AVEVA Historian, AVEVA PEM and AVEVA PLC drivers (DAS and OI).

• Experience with Microsoft Windows Server, Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL.

• A background in production environments or projects.

• Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall and hybrid methods.

• Experience from working in a multicultural environment.

• Fluent English, both written and spoken.

It is an advantage if you also have experience with:

• MES systems.

• PLC (Siemens/Rockwell).

• OPC drivers such as Kepware or OPC Router.

• SAP MII.

• GitHub and Azure DevOps.

• C++, .NET, C# or VB.NET.

What do we offer?

This position is based in Aarhus, Denmark or Gdańsk, Poland, and you should expect approximately 20 travel days per year, primarily to our sites across Europe. You will help support Europe’s largest dairies, a wide range of products and the farmers who own Arla through great IT solutions, making a real difference for the entire organization and your colleagues near and far.

Would you like to join us?

If you want to help us create the dairy of the future, we would love to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For more information, please contact Arne Bo Jensen, Senior Manager - Head of IT Product on aboj@arlafoods.com.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for a dedicated, structured and development-oriented Fulfilment Operations Team Leader to join IKEA Odense. You are passionate about leadership, optimising logistics processes and achieving results through people.

This is a fixed-term position consisting of two exciting assignments. You will initially join our Outbound team, focusing on outgoing online orders, before transitioning to our Inbound team, where the focus will be on incoming goods flow. This will give you the opportunity to work with two key areas of our logistics operation and contribute to creating efficient workflows, high quality standards and great customer experiences.

In both roles, your most important task will be to deliver results through visible leadership, strong collaboration and the continuous development of both employees and processes.

To succeed in this role, it is important that you:

•Have 1–2 years of leadership experience, preferably with a focus on people and team management.

•Are fluent in both Danish and English, written and spoken.

•Are well organised and able to maintain an overview in a busy and changing environment.

•Are motivated by developing people, creating engagement and achieving strong results through your team.

•Have an analytical and solution-oriented approach to operations, processes and optimisation.

•Ideally have experience in logistics – this is an advantage, but not a requirement.

•Ideally hold a forklift licence or are interested in obtaining one.

You must be comfortable working varying hours depending on your area of responsibility. In Outbound, working hours will be flexible between 06:00 and the evening, while in Inbound, working hours will be 04:00–12:00.

During the first part of the position, from approximately January 2027 to May 2027, you will be the Team Leader of our Outbound operation. Together with your team, you will ensure that our online orders are handled efficiently and dispatched to our customers on time.

From May 2027, you will transition to our Inbound team, where you will cover a maternity leave position. Here, your focus will be on ensuring an efficient and well-functioning inbound goods flow, making sure that goods are handled correctly and on time and are available to the rest of our logistics operation.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

•Leading, developing and motivating a team of approximately 20 employees.

•Ensuring efficient daily operations and a stable flow of outgoing online orders and incoming goods.

•Optimising outflow, workflows and processes, with a focus on productivity, quality and costs.

•Planning and coordinating resources to ensure that operational targets are achieved.

•Creating a culture focused on continuous improvement, accountability and collaboration.

•Monitoring relevant KPIs, customer satisfaction and operational performance.

•Ensuring employee well-being and actively working with sickness absence and employee retention.

•Ensuring that all work is carried out in accordance with IKEA's applicable safety rules and procedures.

TOGETHER AS A TEAM

At IKEA Logistics, we play a central role in creating great customer experiences. Every day, we work to ensure that the right products are available, handled efficiently and moved further through the supply chain, always keeping the customer at the centre of everything we do.

We believe there is always room for improvement and that great results are achieved through engaged employees, clear leadership and strong collaboration.

As a Team Leader, you will play an important role in translating our goals into tangible results in everyday operations. You must be able to provide direction for your team, develop employees' skills and ensure that we continuously find new and better ways of working.

QUESTIONS AND SUPPORT? LET'S CONNECT!

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Fulfilment Operations Manager Rune Nielsen at rune.nielsen@ingka.ikea.com.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. All applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

Additional information

•This is a fixed-term position with 1st of January 2027 as expected start date until summer 2028.

•The position is based on an average of 37 hours per week.

•From January to May 2027, working hours will be flexible between 06:00 and the evening, depending on operational requirements.

•From June 2027 until summer 2028, working hours will generally be 04:00–12:00.

The position is available from 01 April 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Re-advertisement: Multi-physics modelling of wetting–drying induced ground movement, landslides and coastal erosion

Research area and project description
We are looking for a motivated and talented PhD candidate to join our multidisciplinary research team investigating climate-driven geohazards affecting infrastructure and the built environment. The successful candidate will become part of the long-term Villum Foundation research programme Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment (CEBE), bringing together researchers in geotechnical, structural, coastal and environmental engineering.

The PhD project focuses on developing a multi-physics platform to simulate the coupled hydromechanical behaviour of soil interacting with water in a geotechnical context. The overall objective is to establish a combination of numerical methods under the umbrella of multi-physics modelling to assess the stability of slopes and embankments subjected to wetting–drying cycles, changes in groundwater level and saturation, surface erosion from stormwater and debris, and toe erosion from waves in coastal environments.

The integrated modelling tool should describe the onset of slope instability, accounting for different hydroclimatic triggering factors (including variations induced by climate change scenarios), and the evolution of mass movement, considering large deformation. Therefore, different numerical methods may be combined, leveraging on the advantages of each approach for simulating a specific phase of the process. It is not the intent to develop new constitutive models for specific soil types, but it may be relevant to explore the use of meso-scale models for soils such as till and fissured clays, both native to Denmark. However, while the main application should be Danish soils, the numerical framework should be developed with versatility in mind to allow the assessment of climate-driven geohazards generally in urban and coastal regions.

Project description 
Applicants should submit a short research proposal (maximum 4 000 keystrokes) that demonstrates their understanding of the scientific challenge, identifies key knowledge gaps, formulates research objectives and hypotheses, outlines a possible methodological approach, and explains why their background makes them well-suited for the project. The proposal will be refined together with the supervisors during the PhD.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a BSc degree (180 ECTS) in civil engineering (or a closely related engineering discipline) and an MSc degree (minimum 90 ECTS) with a specialisation in geotechnical engineering, or computational engineering or coastal engineering, including advanced coursework in numerical methods, finite element analysis, and geotechnical engineering.

Further requirements:
• Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English are required.
• Applicants are expected to have experience in numerical modelling.
• Demonstrated programming skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB, Fortran, C++, or a similar scientific programming language) are required.
Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Navitas, Inge Lehmanns Gade 10, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

jobs.occupation: Technical Project Manager – Production Support & Technical Purchasing, GN Hearing, Præstø
jobs.description:
**Are you ready to manage technical projects that help ensure reliable, compliant, and scalable manufacturing of medical electronic devices? We are looking for a Technical Project Manager within Production Support & Technical Purchasing who will lead initiatives that support production continuity, equipment upgrades, validation activities, and supplier collaboration across our manufacturing environment.

**In the role our new Technical Project Manager in the Component Manufacturing Engineering team under Global Operations, you will connect engineering, operations, quality, and suppliers to deliver robust manufacturing solutions and support uninterrupted production.

**The team you will be part of:

**You will join Component Manufacturing Engineering within Global Operations. The team supports the manufacture of electronic components and assemblies through technical project delivery, production engineering, equipment development, and supplier collaboration.

We work closely across Manufacturing Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and external partners to improve processes, manage change responsibly, and deliver quality outcomes. We value practical problem-solving, clear collaboration, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

**Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:

**

• Scope and deliver production engineering projects that optimize manufacturing processes, electronic test environments, and assembly-line layouts

• Manage equipment transfers, capacity expansions, and hardware and software upgrades to support stable and scalable production

• Coordinate manufacturing changes and risk assessments with Operations and Quality to help prevent supply chain or production interruptions

• Support the implementation of automated test equipment and calibration protocols for PCBAs and sub-assemblies

• Manage technical sourcing initiatives for manufacturing equipment, tooling, production components, and automated test stations

• Build productive supplier relationships and negotiate agreements covering pricing, lead times, service levels, and statements of work

• Support validation and documentation activities, including IQ/OQ/PQ, change controls, SOPs, and audit-ready equipment records

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Bring a relevant technical degree within electrical, electronic, mechanical, or manufacturing engineering, or a related field

• Have experience managing production engineering, manufacturing, or technical projects within a regulated industry, preferably medical devices, automotive, or aerospace

• Bring knowledge of electronics manufacturing, including SMD production, PCBAs, electronic assemblies, power supplies, or electromechanical components

• Have experience coordinating technical teams and resources, while creating alignment across engineering, operations, quality, and suppliers

• Bring experience with quality frameworks, validation, change management, technical purchasing, and supplier negotiations; knowledge of ISO 13485 is beneficial

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 5 December 2026. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**Genmab’s CMC Writing team is growing, and we are looking for a Senior CMC Writer to support global regulatory submissions across our expanding portfolio.

Your primary focus will be documentation for global Biologics License Applications (BLAs), Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAAs), New Drug Applications (NDAs), and responses to health authority questions during assessment. Working closely with scientific and technical experts, you will transform complex CMC information into clear, accurate, and consistent regulatory submission documents.

You will join a dedicated team of CMC writers collaborating across early and late-stage development, regulatory submission, and lifecycle management. As a senior colleague, you will independently drive writing activities, provide expert review and mentoring, and help improve documentation practices through AI and digital tools.

The position reports to the Director, Head of CMC Writing, and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your responsibilities include:

• Independently authoring and coordinating review of Module 3 CTD sections and supporting source documents covering manufacturing processes and controls, analytical procedures, characterization, specifications, formulation development, stability, and facilities

• Working with CMC Project Managers, subject matter experts, Regulatory Affairs CMC, Quality Assurance, and external partners to resolve review comments and deliver approved documents within agreed timelines

• Serving as a go-to reviewer for scientific accuracy, document quality, consistency, and regulatory alignment, including verification of data against source documentation

• Authoring and coordinating responses to health authority questions and maintaining the resulting updates across submissions and programs

• Supporting late stage initial filings, global roll outs, lifecycle maintenance, including post-approval changes, and contributing to IND/CTA submissions and amendments as needed, while maintaining source document trackers and traceability

• Applying and refining CMC writing and response principles, templates, procedures, and style guides in accordance with Genmab’s quality system and applicable GxP requirements

• Using AI, automation, and digital tools to identify documentation gaps and improve writing quality and efficiency, with critical evaluation of outputs and appropriate handling of confidential information

• Mentoring colleagues in regulatory writing and digital documentation practices, and contributing to process improvements and departmental initiatives

**Requirements

**You hold a master’s degree in science or a related technical discipline. An advanced degree, relevant certification, or equivalent experience is preferred.

You bring at least six years of experience in CMC or a related field within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and/or medical device industry, with relevant experience in biologics and/or chemical development and manufacturing. We welcome candidates with backgrounds in biologics, small molecules, or both.

**In Addition, You Have

**

• Experience in global regulatory submissions and pharmaceutical or biotechnology product development and manufacturing. Direct experience supporting IND, CTA, BLA, MAA, or NDA filings is expected

• Demonstrated expertise in authoring and reviewing complex CMC regulatory sections and/or supporting source documents, with the ability to independently manage writing activities and guide other authors

• A good understanding of CMC regulatory expectations across development stages and strong knowledge of CTD structure, GxP, and relevant documentation requirements

• Excellent written English, sound scientific judgment, and the ability to present complex information clearly, assess supporting data, and identify gaps and inconsistencies

• Practical experience using AI to improve scientific or technical writing quality and efficiency, including effective prompting, critical assessment of outputs, and verification of scientific content

• Strong communication and influencing skills, enabling you to align cross-functional stakeholders, resolve differing perspectives, and mentor colleagues

• A proven record of ownership, effective prioritization, and timely delivery, combined with curiosity, continuous learning, and a collaborative approach that builds trust, welcomes feedback, and supports an inclusive work environment

**Application deadline: 30 November 2026

**The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**About The Job

**Do you thrive in a dynamic group function within an international organisation, working alongside like-minded and passionate colleagues? Do you have a solid foundation in audit or financial controlling and are you ready to take the next step in your career?

Then come join Saxo and play a key role in our financial and regulatory reporting while expanding your expertise in group reporting, IFRS reporting and regulatory reporting.

We are looking for a Financial Controller to join our skilled, dedicated and energetic reporting team of five employees, which is overall responsible for our IFRS Annual Report, including the group controlling and consolidation of more than 10 companies and regulatory reporting. You will be reporting directly to the Head Financial Controlling.

A few words from our Hiring Manager, Head of Financial Controlling, on the exciting position:

“If you enjoy working in a dynamic area, are ambitious in terms of taking on new challenges and developing your financial reporting skills alongside a strong team, this is the position for you. You will work together with a fantastic team. “

Our financial controlling team is responsible for monthly group consolidation and reporting processes, IFRS Group Annual Report and regulatory reporting to the Danish authorities. Further, we are responsible for coordination with the external auditors.

We are working together with Head of Financial Compliance who is our IFRS expert and moreover we work closely with the Commercial Finance team.

**Responsibilities

**In this role you will be a key player in Saxo’s external reporting procedures spanning from external reporting, optimisation of processes and working with our consolidation system.

To succeed in this role you should be curious, eager to learn and motivated to develop your controlling and reporting skills while contributing to the solving of complex accounting issues with support from experienced colleagues. You will be able to engage in close collaboration with the rest of your team as well as with our many stakeholders throughout a truly international organisation.

**Your profile

**

• 2-4 years of experience from an auditing firm or working within financial controlling

• Experience with complex accounting, reporting or audit engagements, providing exposure to a broad range of financial reporting topics and business environments

• Relevant degree in Finance or Accounting (e.g. Bachelor's degree or HD, including candidates currently pursuing an HD degree)

• Proficient in English both verbal and written and comfortable navigating an international organisation

• Experience in the financial sector is not a prerequisite

Furthermore, we are looking for a candidate who is structured, analytical and self-motivated. Someone with focus on effective problem solving while working with tight deadlines. You are a team player who enjoys collaborating with others and contributing with new perspectives.

Additionally, you have a proactive mindset and are comfortable taking on unfamiliar tasks.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

_Are you an Executive Assistant, motivated by balancing calendars and strategic priorities, and with a strong flair for communication? Would you like a seat at the table where we help shape the green energy transition in a safe and sustainable manner? Here is a unique opportunity for you!

_**Your position

**Our current Executive Assistant is retiring, and therefore we are now searching for a new Executive Assistant for the CEO. You will be working in close partnership with the CEO, you will help ensure the smooth execution of key priorities, initiatives, and day-to-day business activities.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, the hub of the Danish energy industry, right on the waterfront – views do not get any better than this. The position is full-time, and you can expect 30+ travel days per year.

_"The unique thing about this role is the combination of trust, responsibility, and visibility. You will be involved where decisions are made, gain insight few people have access to, and play a key role in turning strategy into action."

__CEO, Steen Brødbæk

_**Your Tasks & Responsibilities

**As an Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will take lead and continuously optimize the CEO’s calendar, balancing strategic priorities, operational needs, stakeholder commitments, travel, and sufficient preparation time.

**Your Tasks Will Include But Are Not Limited To

**

• Executive office coordination: Maintain an effective operating rhythm for the CEO’s office and support selected Executive Leadership Team meetings, leadership events, and governance activities.

• Stakeholder management: Build trusted relationships with executives, Board representatives, owners, customers, colleagues, and external partners; manage requests with sound judgement and appropriate diplomacy.

• Meeting preparation and follow-through: Coordinate agendas and materials, ensure the CEO is well briefed, capture decisions and actions where relevant, and drive timely follow-up.

• Communication support: Draft, coordinate, and quality-check correspondence, presentations, briefing notes, public relations/press, and other executive materials in close cooperation with relevant functions (incl. external media consultants).

• Travel and logistics: Plan travel and ensure that practical arrangements, briefing materials, schedules, and contingencies are managed seamlessly.

• Continuous improvement: Simplify routines, use digital and AI-enabled tools responsibly, and identify opportunities to stop, automate, delegate, or improve administrative work.

**Your Profile & Qualifications

**We are looking for a trustworthy and positive Executive Assistant who is passionate about supporting executive leadership and helping turn strategy into action. With a proactive and well-organized approach, you enjoy building relationships across all levels of the organization and take pride in creating impact through coordination, communication, and execution.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex calendars, competing priorities, confidential matters, and senior stakeholders.

• Strong business understanding and the ability to grasp context, connect issues, and distinguish critical priorities from noise.

• Preference for Danish speaker, professional fluency in English is required (corporate language is English).

• High digital fluency across Microsoft 365 and modern collaboration tools, with sound judgement in the use of AI-enabled solutions.

• Relevant administrative, commercial, communication, or business education; equivalent experience may substitute for formal qualifications.

• Experience working in an international company, across cultures and time zones.

**Welcome to Semco Maritime

**At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

Dig deep. Find the needle. Grow the margin.

Do you love diving into data until you find that opportunity that makes the impossible business case possible? Do you get a kick out of turning a small, complex and creative insight into real profitability? And do you want to be the analytical engine and enabler behind a growing portfolio? Then you might be our new Portfolio Specialist within parallel import.

Make a real difference to a growing portfolio

Our business is growing fast, with more products, more markets and more competition on both the sales and purchasing side. That is why we have established Portfolio Management: a cross-functional department that steers demand and supply for our active portfolio across our European markets.

As Portfolio Specialist, you will work side by side with our Portfolio Managers and continuously find new ways to improve the profitability and accessibility of our active portfolio through new and cheaper sourcing, higher product availability and adding existing products to new sales markets. You will collaborate closely with Business Development, Sales, Purchasing, and regulatory, and your work will combine structured portfolio reviews with ad hoc tasks when changes in demand or supply call for fast and focused action.

Your primary tasks

• Continuously review the active portfolio to identify opportunities for optimization and development within the regulatory framework of each market.

• Find new, cheaper and alternative sourcing options that strengthen both profitability and product availability.

• Identify new sales opportunities for existing products together with Sales.

• Prepare analyses and business cases that support the Portfolio Managers’ decisions.

• Handle ad hoc optimization of specific products when demand or supply shifts, and show where action creates the most value.

Who are you?

Curious, persistent and never satisfied with the first answer. You love working with data, lots of it, you find energy in adding profitability, and you keep digging until you find the needle in the haystack. You understand that every opportunity must hold up within the regulatory requirements of each market, and you naturally keep building your regulatory knowledge and market dynamic know-how, so your analysis stays focused on what is possible. You are structured enough to drive continuous portfolio reviews and flexible enough to switch gears when an urgent request lands on your desk. You build strong relationships across the business, share your insights generously and challenge assumptions across the value chain constructively.

You may have a degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Supply Chain or similar, and preferably some experience with data analysis, business cases or pricing, ideally from pharma within parallel import or generics. You are strong in Excel, navigate complex IT systems with ease and get energy from automating whatever can be automated. Experience with BI tools is a big plus, and you communicate fluently in English and Danish.

What we offer

Reporting to the Head of Portfolio Management, you will join a brand-new department with strong ambitions, high visibility and a direct impact on 2care4’s profitability. We are moving towards an increasingly automated environment, where we challenge the "as is" and set the bar high for replacing manual tasks with smart systems and automated calculations, so more time goes to the analyses that matter. You will help shape that journey in a cooperative, informal culture where we share knowledge, use yesterday’s lessons to build a stronger tomorrow, and enjoy a good laugh along the way. You will get thorough onboarding, a manager who invests in your development and colleagues who are always ready to help, because when you grow, so does the portfolio.

Our head office in Esbjerg is your home base. You will work from Esbjerg at least two days a week, and during onboarding you will spend most of your time here, so you get the best possible start with the team and the business. Beyond that, you can use our growing office in Odense and work from home when it makes sense for you and the team. We believe the best results are created together, so most of your week will be spent at one of our offices. We value close communication and direct collaboration with our stakeholders and 5-15 days of traveling per year is expected.

Do you want to grow together?

Apply via the application link with your application and CV. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. For further information, contact Daniel Justesen, Head of Portfolio Management, at dju@2care4.dk

About 2care4

2care4 is an international pharmaceutical company headquartered in Esbjerg, Denmark. Our mission is to make medicines more accessible to patients across Europe, and every day we strive to create value through quality, innovation and strong partnerships.
